title: 第一卷 第19章 贞操是男人最好的嫁妆第一卷 第20章 明月绝不拖累大家
slug: 失踪十年小师妹让全宗门跪下迎接
content_zh:
雷子越扶着苏明月回到自己的位置坐好。
周围所有弟子都在看他们。
他们不知道苏明月内心的盘算，只看见她路过云爻太上长老与小师叔，恰巧灵船颠簸，她不小心摔倒，然后——被洛还真结结实实一拳打飞了出去。
“洛师妹太过分了，一碗葡萄而已，压了就压了，居然直接动手。”
“是啊，苏师妹身体本就弱，哭成那样，不知道有多痛。”
“可是，那不是普通的葡萄，那是云爻长老亲手剥的葡萄。要是云爻长老给我剥，我也会拿命守护！”
苏明月虽然在宗门很受欢迎。
但比起云爻，还是差了一大截。
但也有一小部分弟子的关注点在别的地方：
“只有我觉得苏师妹有点弱吗？怎么炼气期一拳就把她伤成那样？”
“是啊，我记得她前几日突破了金丹中期，宗主和雷师兄赵师兄他们还为她举办了庆祝的小聚。”
“啧，很明显嗑丹药嗑的呗。我要是有丹红长老和赵青师兄无限供给丹药，我也能这么快进阶……”
有云爻长老的极品丹药，苏明月很快恢复过来。
听见这些质疑与贬低，苏明月面上依旧一副柔弱苍白的模样，但是心里却满是鄙夷。
他们说这些话，不过是嫉妒她有人疼有人爱罢了。
至于说她弱，经不住洛还真一拳？
哼。
方才自己只是一时间没有设防，才被伤得那么重，否则洛还真一个小小炼气期，怎么可能伤得了自己，让她在云爻的面前丢这么大的面子。
不过，这个事情也怪云爻没有边界感，没事给洛还真剥什么葡萄。
他难道不明白，贞操是男人最好的嫁妆？

虽然看见自己受伤后，他第一时间关心地给出了极品疗伤丹……苏明月幽怨地瞪了云爻一眼。
不过，接下来自己是不能接近云爻了。
她和洛还真犯冲。有洛还真在，好像做什么事情都不顺利。
还是等进了秘境，彻底解决掉洛还真，再慢慢攻略云爻也不急。
想到洛还真不久就会死掉，苏明月的脸色才逐渐好了起来。
一日后，灵船抵达秘境。
秘境名为灵山秘境，相传灵山是一个上古时期正道宗门的旧址，宗门古修士们有的羽化飞升，有的则寿元耗尽坐化，只余下偌大的宗门和宗门内无数琼花秘宝。
随着时间的推移，天地灵气不断汇聚遗址，在时空乱流的影响下形成一处大型秘境。
灵山秘境每隔三年打开一次，秘境只允许元婴期以下的修士作为“新弟子”入宗寻道。
秘境口人满为患，是来自各个宗门元婴期以下的弟子们。
天空中浮现出渡了一层金色光晕的灵山虚影。虚影正在不断变大，并缓缓落地。
随着虚影变成一座绵延千里的巨山，顶天立地的巨型漩涡石头门出现在众人面前。
content_en:
Lei Ziyue helped Su Mingyue return to her seat and sit down.
All the disciples around were looking at them.
They didn't know Su Mingyue's inner thoughts. They only saw her passing by the Supreme Elder Yunyao and his junior uncle. The ship happened to bump and she accidentally fell down, and then - she was punched out by Luo Huanzhen.
"Junior sister Luo is going too far. It's just a bowl of grapes. Just press them. You actually do it directly."
"Yes, Junior Sister Su is already weak. It hurts to cry like that."
"But, those are not ordinary grapes, they are grapes peeled by Elder Yun Yao himself. If Elder Yun Yao peels them for me, I will protect them with my life!"
Although Su Mingyue is very popular in the sect.
But compared to Yun Yao, it is still far behind.
But there are also a small number of disciples who focus on other things:
"Am I the only one who thinks Junior Sister Su is a little weak? How come she was injured like that with just one punch during the Qi refining period?"
"Yes, I remember that she broke through the middle stage of the golden elixir a few days ago. The sect master and Senior Brother Lei and Senior Brother Zhao also held a small gathering for her to celebrate."
"Tsk, it's obvious that he took pills. If I had elder Danhong and senior brother Zhao Qing to supply unlimited pills, I could advance so quickly..."
With Elder Yunyao's top-grade elixir, Su Mingyue recovered quickly.
After hearing these questions and belittling, Su Mingyue still looked weak and pale on her face, but her heart was filled with contempt.
They said these things just because they were jealous that she was loved and loved by others.
As for saying she was weak, she couldn't withstand Luo's punch?
snort.
Just now, she was injured so badly because she was undefended for a while. Otherwise, Luo was still in a small period of refining her Qi. How could she have hurt herself and made her lose such face in front of Yun Yao.
However, this matter is also due to Yun Yao's lack of sense of boundaries. He really peeled grapes for Luo when he had nothing to do.
Doesn't he understand that chastity is a man's best dowry?
Although after seeing himself injured, he immediately gave the best healing pill out of concern... Su Mingyue glared at Yun Yao resentfully.
However, he will not be able to get close to Yun Yao next.
She and Luo really clashed. With Luo really here, nothing seems to go well.
It’s better to wait until we enter the secret realm, completely eliminate Luo Huanzhen, and then slowly conquer Yunyao. There is no rush.
Thinking that Luo Huazhen would die soon, Su Mingyue's complexion gradually improved.
One day later, the spirit ship arrived at the secret realm.
The secret realm is called Lingshan Secret Realm. According to legend, Lingshan is the site of a righteous sect in ancient times. Some of the ancient monks of the sect became immortals and ascended, while others ran out of life and died, leaving only the huge sect and countless secret treasures of Qionghua in the sect.
As time goes by, the spiritual energy of heaven and earth continues to gather at the ruins, forming a large secret realm under the influence of the turbulence of time and space.
The secret realm of Lingshan is opened every three years. The secret realm only allows monks below the Nascent Soul stage to enter the sect as "new disciples" to seek the path.
The entrance to the secret realm was overcrowded, including disciples from various sects and below the Nascent Soul stage.
The phantom of Lingshan with a layer of golden halo appeared in the sky. The shadow is growing bigger and slowly falling to the ground.
As the shadow turned into a huge mountain stretching for thousands of miles, a giant whirlpool stone door towering over the sky appeared in front of everyone.
